gloss: waitress at a traditional Japanese inn or restaurant

definitions.gloss: waitress at a traditional Japanese inn or restaurant
definitions.explanation: A woman who serves food and attends to guests at a ryokan (traditional inn) or traditional Japanese-style restaurant. The role involves not just serving meals but also providing hospitality and attending to guests' comfort.

examples.english: It was memorable how the waitress, dressed in a kimono, greeted us with a smile.

notes:
The polite form of ⟦{仲居|なかい}→仲居：11719_nakai⟧, always used with さん in everyday speech. Refers specifically to female attendants at traditional Japanese inns (⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧) and high-end Japanese restaurants (⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧). The role goes beyond food service — {仲居|なかい}さん welcome guests, serve meals course by course, lay out futons, and ensure overall comfort. They traditionally wear kimono.

- {仲居|なかい}さん⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a nakai-san

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {仲居|なかい}さん is an iconic figure of Japanese hospitality culture. At a ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧, the {仲居|なかい}さん assigned to your room is often your primary point of contact throughout your stay.
